title: Ring of Exalted Marrow

sources.title: Ghoulish Touch
markers: elves and undead can be paralysed

summary: Casts a command for Undead and a touch attack that can paralyze.

fields.Exhort the Risen: Level 1, Action, 60 ft, once per Long Rest. One Undead makes a Wisdom save against spell save DC or follows a one-turn command. Choose Halt, Grovel (fall Prone), Flee, Drop weapon, or Approach.
fields.Ghoulish Touch: Level 1, Action, melee spell attack, once per Long Rest. On hit deal 2d6 Necrotic. DC 13 Constitution save prevents Paralysed for 2 turns. The source reports Elves and Undead can be affected despite the tooltip.
fields.Paralysed: Cannot move or act, automatically fails Strength and Dexterity saves, and attacks against it have advantage. Hits from within 10 ft are critical.
fields.Acquisition: Heavy chest at the altar on the Moonrise Towers rooftop, X −153, Y −170.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
